fsSection.title: FORMULA STUDENT
fsSection.description: The Formula Student competition not only tests the performance of the car but also engineering knowledge and management skills. Participants are divided into classes depending on the type of car - electric (EV) or combustion (CV). In some editions, there is also the possibility to compete in the optional autonomous category (DV). The competition consists of several scored events, which are divided into static and dynamic. The team with the highest number of points out of a thousand possible is declared the winner of their class. The scoring method varies slightly between editions.

teamSection.title: Team
teamSection.subtitle: A few words about us
teamSection.description1: Young, ambitious, committed and courageous – this is the best way to describe the students of Wrocław University of Science and Technology, especially the Members of the PWR Racing Team. Our organisation operates on a structure similar to that found in large companies. It is headed by a three-person Management Board.
teamSection.description2: The Team Leader bears the greatest responsibility for its activities and development. He works with the Financial Director and the Technical Leader, who coordinates the work of the Leaders of the individual Departments – Composites, Mechanical, Electrical, Software and Vehicle Performance. The Marketing and Business Departments are exceptions, as they report directly to the Team Leader. Each Member of the PWR Racing Team reports to their Department Leader.

historySection.title: TEAM HISTORY
historySection.subtitle: HISTORY OF OUR TEAM
historySection.description: PWR Racing Team is the oldest and most successful Formula Student Team in Poland. Since its inception in 2009, we have designed and constructed a total of 16 vehicles, including 12 combustion engine cars and four electric cars equipped with autonomous driving systems. We are currently working on our fifth design of this type. From season to season, we consistently improve our vehicles by implementing increasingly innovative engineering solutions. Over the course of 16 years of activity, we have taken first place in the overall classification of Formula Student competitions three times, thus winning entire editions. This happened for the first time in 2017 during the Formula SAE Italy competition, then in the 2022/2023 season during the first Polish edition of the competition. Our latest victory came in 2025 during the Formula Student Easter competition, where, in addition to triumphing in the overall classification, we also won four competitions - two dynamic and two static. We currently hold the title of the best Polish Formula Student Team.

footer.seasonDescription: Each season, we create a new Formula Student racing car. We have twelve unique combustion engine models to our credit, each one easily outperforming the previous one. In 2022, the team's first ever electric car with autonomous driving systems was built – the RT12e. We are currently working on our seventeenth design, including the fifth of its kind – the RT16e.

navAbout.paragraph1: PWR Racing Team is a Strategic Research Club at Wrocław University of Technology and the oldest and most successful Formula Student racing team in Poland. Since 2009, a group of about 90 students from Wrocław universities has been designing and constructing racing cars every year, which compete in prestigious international engineering competitions around the world. The greatest success of the PWR Racing Team is its victory in the Formula Student Easter competition in 2025, including 1st place in the overall classification and wins in four competitions - Endurance, Efficiency, Cost and Manufacturing, and Business Plan Presentation. Another important milestone in the Team's history was winning the entire Formula SAE Italy competition in 2017. It was the first victory for a Polish Formula Student Team in history.
navAbout.paragraph2: Over the years, the Team has constructed 12 combustion engine racing cars, which have repeatedly taken top places in Formula Student competitions in Europe and around the world. Responding to dynamic changes in the automotive industry, PWR Racing Team took on a new challenge and made the transition to electric drive in just one year. At the same time, a set of innovative solutions enabling autonomous driving was developed. As a result, in 2022, the first electric car with autonomous driving systems was created – the RT12e. Work is currently underway on the fifth racing car of this type – the RT16e.
navAbout.paragraph3: The design and construction of a Formula Student racing car is an advanced, interdisciplinary engineering project that enables the development of young engineers and future managers. It requires enormous commitment from the Team, translating into thousands of hours that Members spend in the workshop and on design and construction work. The project is made possible thanks to the support of Wrocław University of Science and Technology, the City of Wrocław, the Manus Foundation and around 150 partners – companies and institutions from all over Europe.

garage.title: Garage
garage.paragraph: Our workshops – garages where we work on our cars with passion and commitment – are located at 16 Sopocka Street, in a quiet neighbourhood of Wrocław. These six spacious garages are our zone of creativity and innovation, where every day the PWR Racing Team faces new engineering challenges. Each garage is tailored to the specific needs of our departments, providing optimal conditions for working on the suspension, aerodynamics, electronics and autonomous systems of our racing cars. This space not only promotes technological development, but also serves as a place for team integration, knowledge exchange and joint problem solving.

departmentsAbout.title: OUR DEPARTMENTS
departmentsAbout.interestedIn: WHICH DEPARTMENT ARE YOU INTERESTED IN?
departmentsAbout.sectionSubtitle: In our department, you will take care of:

mechanical.description: The department is responsible for designing and building the suspension system. It is also responsible for the elements of the autonomous steering and braking systems, mounting parts, and metal structures in the monocoque.

responsibility1.text: designing and building the suspension system

responsibility2.text: designing and building elements of the autonomous steering system

responsibility3.text: designing and building the braking system

responsibility4.text: designing mounting parts and metal structures in the monocoque

composites.description: The department is responsible for the handmade production of all composite elements present in the bolid. Starting from the largest element, the load-bearing structure, through the aerodynamic package, to the driver's ergonomics and the protective structure for the high-voltage battery.

responsibility1.text: modeling composite elements in CAD programs

responsibility2.text: strength simulations and optimization of composite structures

responsibility3.text: CFD simulations of the aerodynamic package

responsibility4.text: production and strength testing of composite elements

marketing.description: The department responsible for the team's image and promoting its activities on social media. Additionally, it handles logistics and event organization.

software.description: The department is responsible for developing the autonomous system and programming microprocessors that control the driver's interface, braking, or steering of the vehicle. It is responsible for the operation of path planning, vehicle control, and perception systems when the driver is not in the bolid. The software is written in programming languages such as C, C++, and Python.

responsibility1.text: developing algorithms that improve autonomous driving

electrical.description: The department is responsible for designing PCBs, creating high and low voltage harnesses, and building a custom high-voltage battery.

responsibility2.text: designing in CAD programs and manufacturing high and low voltage harnesses compliant with motorsport standards

responsibility3.text: modeling housings for electronics in CAD programs

responsibility5.text: thermal simulations of electronics and batteries

vehiclePerformance.description: The department is responsible for maximizing vehicle performance, vehicle kinematics and dynamics, data acquisition, powertrain, and test organization.

business.description: Department responsible for contact with partners, financial management of the Team, and preparation of static competition for Formula Student competitions, such as business presentation.

responsibility1.text: Coordination of orders, data analysis, optimization of the Team's work

acceleration.title: Acceleration
acceleration.text: A competition that involves covering 75 meters as quickly as possible, thus assessing the acceleration of the car. Teams have two attempts, and the better one is evaluated.

skidPad.title: Skid Pad
skidPad.text: A competition involving driving in a “figure-eight” pattern. Each team has two attempts, and the better one is considered for scoring.

autocross.title: Autocross
autocross.text: A competition where participants aim to complete one lap of the track in the shortest time possible. Two drivers from each team can participate, each having two runs. The best time from the four runs is considered.

endurance.title: Endurance
endurance.text: A competition involving a race of about 22 kilometers. After 11 kilometers, there is a driver change, which the team has 3 minutes to complete. This is the highest-scoring competition, but only teams that finish the race receive points.

cost.title: Cost and Manufacturing
cost.text: A competition that evaluates the accuracy of the project cost estimate and the team members' knowledge of material and manufacturing costs of the car.

engineering.title: Engineering Design
engineering.text: A competition involving the presentation of the car design. Judges assess the engineering skills and ingenuity of the team members in designing both the overall vehicle and individual systems. This is the highest-scoring static competition, judged by automotive industry experts.

business.title: Business Plan Presentation
business.text: A competition where team members take on the role of a start-up board, for example, creating custom brake systems. Using a ten-minute presentation, they must convince judges acting as investors to support their business model.

joinUs.recruitmentOpen: Recruitment open! Join us and create something amazing with us. 🚀
joinUs.careerDescription1: In our team, everyone will find space for development – regardless of their field of study or experience. We operate in many areas, from advanced engineering and car design to marketing, PR, and partner relations.
joinUs.careerDescription2: Regardless of whether you are interested in mechanics, electronics, project management, graphics, or social media – PWR Racing Team is a place where your skills matter. We create a team with passion, and every path is equally important on the road to success.

mechanical.description: This department is responsible for the design and construction of the suspension system, autonomous steering and braking components, as well as the mounting and metal structures within the monocoque. Your responsibilities will include participating in work related to each of these areas – from concept to implementation.

electrical.description: This department is responsible for designing PCB boards, creating high and low voltage wiring harnesses, and building a custom high-voltage battery. Your tasks will include designing and manufacturing electronics, modeling enclosures in CAD, designing batteries and CAN bus, as well as conducting thermal simulations of electronic components.

composites.description: This department is responsible for the manual production of all composite elements of the car – from the load-bearing structure, through the aerodynamic package, to ergonomic elements and the high-voltage battery cover. Working with us, you will design components in CAD, conduct strength and CFD simulations, optimize composite structures, and participate in their manufacturing and testing.

software.description: This department is responsible for the development of the autonomous system and programming microcontrollers controlling the driver interface, braking, and steering of the vehicle. We create software in C, C++, and Python, developing perception, path planning, and motion control systems that enable driverless driving. As part of the work, you will develop autonomous driving algorithms and embedded systems.

verticalPerformance.description: This department focuses on maximizing the car's performance through work on its kinematics, dynamics, drivetrain, data acquisition, and test organization. Your tasks will include conducting vehicle dynamics simulations, developing the drivetrain, and analyzing data from runs.

business.description: This department is responsible for partner relations, team financial management, and preparing static events for the Formula Student competition, including the business presentation. Your work will involve coordinating orders, data analysis, process optimization, creating presentations, and maintaining relationships with partners.

marketing.description: This department is responsible for the team's image and promoting its activities on social media. Additionally, it handles logistics and event organization.

teamPage.teamDescription: PWR Racing Team – The Best, Oldest and Most Successful Formula Student Team in Poland
teamPage.raceSeriesDescription: Participant in international Formula Student competitions in countries such as Germany, the Czech Republic, Austria, Hungary, the Netherlands, Poland and others.
teamPage.meetOurTeamDescription: We are the oldest and most successful <link>Formula Student</link> Team in Poland. We currently hold the title of the best team in the country, ranking 1st in Poland and 33rd in the world. We have been operating at the Wrocław University of Science and Technology continuously since 2009. Our team consists of about 90 students from various Wrocław universities who design and build racing cars every year and then compete in prestigious competitions around the world.
teamPage.getToKnowUsDescription1: PWR Racing Team is a Team of students from Wrocław University of Science and Technology, operating continuously since 2009. Every year, we design and build a new racing car – to date, we have created 12 combustion engine cars and three electric cars with autonomous driving systems.
teamPage.getToKnowUsDescription2: We are currently working on the team's sixteenth car – the RT16e. In 2017, we were the first Polish Team to win the Formula SAE Italy competition. Since then, we have consistently remained among the world's best. In 2021, we took 1st place in Poland and 11th place in the world. In the current season, we are once again the best in the country and rank 33rd in the world among 448 teams. In addition, we are among the top three Formula Student Teams in the world with rear-wheel drive.
teamPage.internationalsTracksTitle: PWR RACING TEAM ON THE INTERNATIONAL ARENA
teamPage.internationalsTracksDescription1: PWR Racing Team never slows down! Our Team successfully represents Wrocław University of Science and Technology at international Formula Student competitions. Last season, we competed on tracks in Hungary, the Netherlands, Austria and the Czech Republic, where our car faced the best teams from all over Europe.
teamPage.internationalsTracksDescription2: Thanks to hard work, innovative solutions and excellent teamwork, we achieved high positions in the overall rankings. The greatest achievement of the season was our victory in the Formula Student Easter competition, where we took 1st place in the overall classification and won 4 of the individual competitions.

teamPage.quote1: PWR Racing Team officially confirms its position among the best teams in the world, moving up 95 places to 33rd in the global Formula Student ranking! In addition, the team from Wrocław University of Science and Technology ranks 1st in Poland! It has been named the best and most successful Formula Student team in the country. This is a historic result and proof that the technological ambitions and hard work of the team members are bringing noticeable results on both the regional and international stage.
teamPage.quote2: It was built by over 50 enthusiasts from Wroclaw University of Technology. From the very beginning in 2009, members of PWR RACING TEAM have wanted to compete in the international Formula Student competition.
